# TrustRAG

> An open reliability workbench for retrieval-augmented generation. TrustRAG
> splits an answer into atomic claims, verifies each one against the cited
> corpus with a batch entailment audit, and rewrites the query when confidence
> falls short — before a hallucination reaches the reader.

## What it does

- **Atomic claim decomposition.** Generated prose is parsed into discrete,
  non-overlapping propositional assertions before any citation is aligned.
- **Hybrid retrieval.** Dense vectors and BM25 sparse matches are combined
  with reciprocal rank fusion. Dense alone misses statutory codes and part
  numbers; sparse alone misses paraphrase.
- **Batch entailment audit.** Every atomic claim is scored against every
  retrieved chunk by a cross-encoder. A claim is supported only when an
  entailment score clears the threshold for at least one citation.
- **Bounded self-healing.** Below a confidence threshold of 0.70, a LangGraph
  state machine rewrites the sub-query and widens the retrieval pool, up to two
  attempts, then routes deterministically to abstention.
- **Cryptographic provenance.** Each chunk is checked against the SHA-256 root
  hash of the document it came from. Changed files are discarded; documents
  past their effective date are pruned.
- **Model Context Protocol server.** The same audit is exposed to external
  agents over JSON-RPC 2.0.

## Interfaces

- [Overview](https://trustrag.local/): what the product does and how to run it.
- [API health](https://trustrag.local/api/v1/health): unauthenticated liveness check.
- [OpenAPI schema](https://trustrag.local/openapi.json): the full versioned REST contract.
- [Agent discovery manifest](https://trustrag.local/.well-known/ard.json): the resources this service exposes.

## Running it locally

The product is local-first and air-gapped. It ships no web fonts, calls no
third-party CDN, and sends no visitor telemetry.

```bash
cd apps/api
python -m venv .venv && pip install -e ".[dev,local-models]"
.venv/bin/python -m uvicorn app.main:app --port 8000

cd apps/web
npm install && npm run dev
```

MongoDB runs on `localhost:27017`. The vector store runs in embedded local
mode by default, so no container runtime is required.

## Measurements

Retrieval recall@8 of 0.889 on the internal 27-query reliability fixture.
The methodology, per-query results and the abstention audit are in
`docs/evaluation/`. Figures quoted in the marketing page carry their
provenance inline.

## API

The REST API is versioned under `/api/v1`. `GET /api/v1/health` is
unauthenticated. Everything else requires a bearer token from
`POST /api/v1/auth/login`.
